evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Robustness was evaluated with an automated LLM-as-a-judge framework scoring factual faithfulness, sensitivity to adversarial edits, certainty fidelity, and hallucination rate.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Under term substitution, hallucinations occurred in 28.1-30.1% of GPT-5-mini summaries, compared with 35.3-36.4% for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 41.4-41.9% for MedGemma.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Purpose: To develop and validate a scalable adversarial evaluation framework for assessing the robustness of large language models (LLMs) that generate patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports.
